title: Mau-kin [Feline+] (Origins Mod)
description: An unofficial update to the Feline origin, with some added abilities and weaknesses to make it stand out a little more. With some (vague) inspiration from the Egyption Mau. Needs the mods Apugli, Origins (forge port) to function.
body:
An unofficial update to the Feline origin, with some added abilities and weaknesses to make it stand out a little more. With some (vague) inspiration from the Egyption Mau. Needs Apugli to function.

Current State:

- Some minor text changes from Feline.
- A few updated abilities.
  - Nocturnal keeps night vision applied under water.
  - Strong Ankles allows you to jump a little higher when sneaking.
  - Weak Arms is now singleplayer friendly, allowing you to break natural stone, just at a much slower pace, with strength applied allows mining at normal speeds.
  - Catlike Appearance now applying to phantoms as well, and creepers no longer run away, but remain aloof until attacked (applies to phantoms too).
- Added some new abilities
  - Healing Purr: Spawns a cloud of healing around you for a short period to provide healing to you and entities around yourself.
  - Quickened Pace: Let's you run just a little faster than normal pace.
  - Primarily Carnivorous: Limits your food options to meat, fish, and a few other foods, while eating others can leave you temporarily sick.
  - Restful: You have to sleep every 2-3 days, otherwise you lose your quickened pace and have a little weakness.
